result.title: EasyResearch: Honest Regression, Forecasting and Signal Classification for Researchers Who Do Not Program
result.summary: EasyClassifier showed that researchers who do not program can obtain honest classification results when the correct evaluation is the default. Most applied studies, however, predict a number, forecast a series or classify recordings, and each task has its own way of producing scores that do not hold on new data. We present EasyResearch, open-source analysis cores for regression, time-series forecasting and signal classification, and EasyResearch Desktop, a Windows application that runs these three tasks and EasyClassifier's classification without code. All four follow the same rules: everything learned from data is learned on training data only, models keep their published defaults with fixed seeds, the selected model receives a separate final score, forecasts are never evaluated on shuffled data, and every run writes a report with a Methods paragraph and the references for every method used. We measured whether the reported scores are honest by keeping part of each dataset untouched. In regression (9 public datasets, 90 runs), the common practice overstated R^2 by +2.2 points and the best comparison score by +2.5, while EasyResearch's final score was -1.0; screening predictors on all rows before cross-validation, which EasyResearch does not offer, reported R^2 = 0.27 on pure noise against -0.44 on new data. In forecasting (15 series), shuffled cross-validation over windows of past values promised errors 19% smaller than its chosen models achieved in the untouched future, while EasyResearch's final-period score was unbiased to within 1.5%; the models EasyResearch chose had 14% lower future error, and on random walks shuffled cross-validation chose a machine-learning model in 5 of 5 series, each worse in the future than repeating the last value, which EasyResearch chose 4 times. In signal classification (4 UCR datasets) one method won every comparison and neither estimate was biased.

AI.brief_summary: EasyResearch 提供无代码的回归、时序预测与信号分类分析核心及 Windows 桌面应用，固定默认设置与随机种子，并保留部分数据不参与建模，量化打乱交叉验证、全数据筛选变量等常见做法对报告分数的高估程度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其关于验证协议泄漏与分数乐观偏差的诊断可供核查 LVR/VLM 推理评测流程是否存在类似信息泄漏与收益高估；但论文任务与多模态推理相距较远，这一联系需较多核查。
